note: the catch-all zuò (do); build, manufacture, hold an event and process are kinds of doing
the catch-all yào: want, need, should, must, be willing, choose
two meanings: truly / indeed (真 真实 一定 其实 的确 确实 实在) and very / too / so (太 非常 这么); the intensifiers could take hěn or tài instead
two senses of duì: toward (对 往 向 为 面对) and right / yes (正确 准 嗯); mark the sense (duì#right) as for xīn#new
use and spend: spending money is using it
a thing you can hold (东西 产品 物品 事物) and a matter that happens (事 事情); Mandarin keeps them apart, shì could say the second
always, all along, forever, at any time
produce, make, send out, draw up
give, give as a gift, hand in, provide, for
but; 尽管 (although) also has its own …, dàn-shì …
way and method fit; 行为 (behavior) is how someone acts, not a way to do something; 主意 (idea) is closer to xiǎng-fǎ, which it also has
a moment / a while (一下 一会儿 时刻) and suddenly (突然 忽然); suddenly needs its own form
real, actual, reality, truly, after all
he, she, it; 自己 (oneself) is said with the pronoun it points back to
mouth and opening: kǒu is both in Mandarin
the Chinese language; 语文 is the school subject
outside and surface fit; 自然 (nature) is not "outside"; it could be the world no one made
three meanings: what a thing is for (作用 功能), what a person can do (能力) and what a person may do (权利, a right)
show, display, perform, play a video
be at, exist, in the middle of
not one form: 心 and 精神 use xīn (heart), 新 uses xīn#new; the report reads only the sound
the moon (月 月亮) and a month (月份); Mandarin uses 月 for both, but 月份 could be yuè-de shí-jiān
a son (儿子, family) and a boy (男孩儿, age); the kinship wording rule keeps family words apart
a daughter (女儿, family) and a girl (女孩儿, age); the kinship wording rule keeps family words apart
age (年龄 年纪) and degree (程度); duō dà fits age, degree is how much
big (大) and heavy (重); heavy could be hěn zhòng or nán ná

自己 (oneself) is said with the pronoun it points back to
hello, and hello on the phone
important (重要) and serious (严重); serious could be hěn huài
first and only then: two sides of one frame
the sun (太阳) and a day (日子); rì is both, but 日子 could be tiān
a foot (脚) and a leg (腿); the leg could be the part above the foot
prepare (准备) and repair (修); make it good again is not get it ready
parents and a parent at school
sweet (甜) and cute (可爱); cute is said as sweet only as a figure of speech
number in a row and a number
have a meeting and a meeting
satisfied (满意) and comfortable (舒服); satisfied is about how something turned out, comfortable about the body
a government (政府, a group) and a president (总统, one person)
graduate (毕业, school is over for good) and class is over (下课, for today)
not one form: 样子 and 形状 use different senses of the words; the report reads only the sound
a taxi and take a taxi
enough (够) and give up (放弃); bù yào le fits give up, enough already has hǎo le
food (食品) and bread (面包); bread needs its own form, like miàn zuò-de chī-de dōng-xi
happiness (幸福, a lasting good life) and excited (兴奋, a burst of feeling)
a box (盒子) and a cube (立方体); not every box is square on all six faces
